title: filesystem_read_many input
description: Read every text file in a folder in a single call.

path.description: Folder to read. Use ~/Desktop, ~/Documents, %USERPROFILE%\Desktop, or the bare name Desktop.

extensions.description: Optional whitelist of extensions, e.g. ['.py', '.md']. Case-insensitive. If empty, all text files are included.

recursive.description: If true, subfolders are scanned too. Default false.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files to read. Default 25.

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum size per file in bytes. Default 262144 (256 KB).
